derives_from: docs/fable5-app-integration-readiness/contracts/audit_logging_contract.json (C11, C12) and mock-harness mock_audit_scenarios (MA-01..MA-07); mirrors legal_authority audit tables without any database connection in M1

record_kinds.written: once per adapter call pair, before model call
record_kinds.fields: trace_id, query_hash, as_of_date, alias_hits, chunk_refs, gate_summary; no query text by default, no body text ever
trace_id, refusal_kind (6-kind enum), stage, rule_id, template_id

record_kinds.written: one per citation on answer or unsupported_answer conversion

modes.hash_only_default: query stored as sha256 hash; excerpt fields absent (MA-03)
modes.excerpt_opt_in: QA_MODE_EXCERPT_LOGGING=true adds bounded query excerpt for internal QA triage only; boot check logs the active mode; default off (MA-04)

fail_closed_rules: sink write rejection converts the in-flight response to an error envelope; an answer is never returned unaudited (MA-06)
partial sequence failure (e.g. retrieval_log ok, answer_audit fails) also converts; sequencing is write-then-emit (MA-07)
trace_id propagates through every record of a request so a request is reconstructable from the sink alone (MA-05)

mock_sink_design.storage: in-memory array per request context plus optional dev-only console.debug summary line
mock_sink_design.inspection: getRecords(trace_id) test hook exported only under NODE_ENV=test guard
mock_sink_design.rejection_triggers: reserved SYNTHETIC trigger inputs force write rejection so fail-closed paths are unit-testable
mock_sink_design.no_persistence: nothing written to disk, network, or database in M1

future_binding_not_in_m1: supabase audit sink arrives with F5-05 adapter work under the same O6+O2+O7 gate chain; factory enum in M1 is 'mock' only
